scope: Native GTK3 layout, empty/error/automatic selection and contrast checks on a VM-only Broadway display
limits: Fake release responses; no download/disk/backend operation
OS squashfs mounted read-only with RAM overlay; not a full desktop/polkit test
No host shares, networking, physical media or existing VM images
harness_notes: The storage-only full boot fixture could not start a normal desktop; no OS security policy was relaxed. A focused native GTK VM uses the release squashfs read-only with a RAM overlay and VM-local Broadway display.

Native checks caught an initial 732px minimum height; settings actions were compacted. Initial realization included hidden panels and inflated window size; panels now choose visibility before mapping, with smaller default height including decorations.
Four style/data checks passed before the final height fix; the final complete five-check run passed on the exact packaged GUI source. The preview image was also inspected.
